content: Pighapetita gheniya ngabhonita uloto ghonge, nnyango udindulilwe kunane kwa Chapanga. Na lilobhe lela linyohine likibha ngita lilobhe lya lipenenga, lilongila: “Hobhokela pamba, na nenga naninangiya ilebhe pighapeta ghanga.”
Papa Uhuke gwa Chapanga ngahikila kabhele. Dola, jhumo atamite pa kigoda chenie cha Unahota nkolongwa kunane kwa Chapanga.
Jwenio jwatamile kigoda chenie abhonikina ngita madine gha yachipi na yakiki. Upende gwa matanga ung'alita ngita lighanga lya kijane kukitindila kigoda cha unahota gwenio.

Kukibha na igoda henge ya unahota nkolongwa makome mabhele na ncheche kukitindii kigoda chenie cha unahota, panane jhake bhakatamite ighogholo makome mabhele na ncheche, bheniya ndi bhakibha bhawalite ngobho nhuu ya mbuu na umutwe jhabhe bhawalite hingo jha chaabo.

Kuhumii mu kigoda chenie cha unahota pajhakupitii lumule lwa mbamba na njobhelo na nnindimilo gwa mbamba. Na mule chaba ya mwotu ijhakita palonge jha kigoda chenie cha unahota. Lumule lwenio ndi ihuke chaba ya Chapanga.

Helahela palonge jha kigoda chenie cha unahota pakibha na kilebhe ngita mbwane jha lindala, ibhonikina ngita lighanga liling'ala hake. Pakate jha kigoda chenie pakatindilwe na ihumbi ina ughome ncheche. Ikibha na miho ndii nnonge na kukiogho.
Kihumbi chikitumbwila kibhonikina ngita lihimba na chuubhele kibhonikina ngita ng'ombi na chuutato kibhonikina ngita kumiho jha mundo na cha ncheche kibhonikina ngita litumbuhe liligholoka.
Ihumbi yoha ncheche, kila kihumbi kikibha na mapapanilo chita, mapapanilo gheniya ghakibha na miho nkate na panja. Kilo na muhe ghawelita kujhemba,

content.text: “Nyahinyahi, nyahinyahi, nyahinyahi, Bhambo, Chapanga Jhuna Makakala ghoha

content: Kila kipinde ihumbi yenie ncheche ibhii na ughome pibhannomba na kunnyenyekeya na kunchenguu jwenio jwatamite pa kigoda cha Unahota na jwalama machiko ghoha ghangapeta na kupeta,

ighogholo makome mabhele na ncheche bhala bhakigwiya palonge jha jwenio jwatamite panane jha kigoda cha Unahota na kunnyinamila jwenio ndi jwatamikiya machiko ghoha ghangapeta na kupeta, na kubheka hingo yabhe nnonge jha kigoda cha Unahota na kulonge:

content.text: mitope kupoke ukolo na ichima na makakala.
Nhwalo mwe ndi jhumpangina ilebhe yoha,
na kukupala kwino ngaipanginwa na ibhile.”
